Deviload 2.7.4 adds three calmer themes while keeping Classic as the default.

Open **Settings → Appearance** to choose:

- **Light Liquid Glass:** light panels over a quiet coastal scene, with dark monochrome branding.
- **Matte black:** solid dark surfaces, neutral controls and light monochrome branding.
- **Black Liquid Glass:** smoked dark panels over the same coastal scene, with light monochrome branding.

The selected theme applies to Downloads, Library, Devil Music, settings, Devil Cut and Devil Convert. It is saved on this device and included in settings backups. Switching themes does not restart the app or interrupt music; updating alone keeps Classic unless you select a new theme.

In the new themes, the full-width download controls sit above the queue. Decorative mascots, flames and animated flourishes give way to a quieter interface, while task progress and status remain visible. The supporter board keeps a contrasting background, readable public names and a clear Ko-fi action. Its manual bundled list still works offline and includes no donation amounts or private account details.

The glass effect uses a bundled coastal image, translucent panels and subtle edge refraction where WebGL is available. It does not show the operating system's desktop through the app or use Apple's native Liquid Glass APIs. A fallback works without WebGL, and reduced-transparency settings use solid surfaces.

Existing profiles and updater settings remain compatible. The macOS package remains an unsigned, unnotarized test build; follow the installation instructions in the README.

Full changelog: https://github.com/Pronexsteam/deviload/compare/v2.7.3...v2.7.4
